trim.description: {"fb", "f", "b"}, optional A string with 'f' representing trim from front and 'b' to trim from back. By default, zeros are trimmed on both sides. Front and back refer to the edges of a dimension, with "front" referring to the side with the lowest index 0, and "back" referring to the highest index (or index -1).

axis.description: int or sequence, optional If None, `filt` is cropped such that the smallest bounding box is returned that still contains all values which are not zero. If an axis is specified, `filt` will be sliced in that dimension only on the sides specified by `trim`. The remaining area will be the smallest that still contains all values wich are not zero.

output.description: ------- ndarray or sequence The result of trimming the input. The number of dimensions and the input data type are preserved.
